```{r cv-date, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
# Date shown in the footer. Computed in R with an explicit time zone so the
# CV is dated in Pacific time no matter where it's built (GitHub's build
# machines run on UTC, which is a day ahead in the evening).
cv_date <- format(Sys.time(), "%B %d, %Y", tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
cv_date <- sub(" 0", " ", cv_date)  # "November 02" -> "November 2"
cat("```{=latex}\n\\renewcommand{\\today}{", cv_date, "}\n```\n", sep = "")
```
